column2: # randomly assign values (0 or 1) for alert systems marked as "optional" (value == 2)
mutate(across(all_of(alert_systems_cols), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.x), replace = TRUE), .x)))
mutate(across(all_of(active_systems_cols), ~ ifelse(.x == 2, sample(c(0, 1), size = length(.x), replace = TRUE), .x)))
# count how many alert systems are active per vehicle
# Filter the accidents dataset to include only valid and relevant driving conditions
DR_DRINK == 0, # driver was not under the influence of alcohol
VSURCONDNAME == "Dry", # road surface condition is dry
!grepl("(?i)Yes", SPEEDRELNAME), # exclude cases where speed was related to the crash
!grepl("(?i)Unknown", SPEEDRELNAME), # exclude cases with unknown speed relation
IS_DRIVER_PRESENT == 1 # a driver was present in the vehicle
